scientific_integrity: Existence of polygonal states and second-harmonic dependence were established in prior literature. Exact finite-N factorization, its semisimple spectral counts, and the universal near-collinear slow eigenvalue are the proposed increment. Standalone symbolic and numerical checks supplement, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous positive growth, purely imaginary coupling, zero nonlinear frequency shift, locally noncollinear closed polygons, and local transverse attraction are proved. The singular collinear dynamics and global basins are not classified. Historical priority of finite-N formulas remains uncertain, especially versus earlier Q-dependent incoherent-state literature.
title: Exact finite-population spectrum and slow relaxation of reactive Stuart–Landau polygons
